explanation.headline: Palonosetron is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. posted a discontinuation on 2025-11-14

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include palonosetron as of 2026-10-21.
Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. posted a discontinuation of palonosetron hydrochloride injection on 2025-11-14.
Corvale East holds 84 vials of the 0.05 mg/mL, 5 mL presentation with 4.5 vials used per day, providing 18.7 days on hand.
The rule-based best option is to buy from Apotex Corp., which is not on FDA's shortage list today.
Additional alternate manufacturers include Avyxa Pharma, LLC and BLuePoint Laboratories, neither of which is on FDA's shortage list today.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
